core model: permissions_for_entity derives selectable through the whole layer chain (visible, unlocked, object flags)
gap_found_by_this_task: No product defect: every fixture passed on the first run (2 passed; the only failure was the missing api.md). To keep the RED honest the item proves the fixtures are load-bearing: with the selectable filter weakened to has_pick_geometry() alone, the hidden/locked cases fail, and restoring the filter turns them green.

Pinned: the selection is replaced, not appended; another layer's object is never included; a hidden object of the layer stays out; a locked or hidden layer clears the selection instead of silently keeping a stale one; a slot with no layer selects nothing without an error; the gesture writes no transaction.
reuse_decision: ADAPT the 'gather what may be used' idea; ADD nothing to the product (the policy already existed), and pin it with fixtures.
